_doc: Torii market spec. One entry per market. rule.type = auto rule evaluated by markets.js (nhl_*, cfb_*) or 'manual' (the routine researches the named source and passes --set). close = UTC time trading stops (rules-enforced via <board>/closes). event = when the result becomes known. Board must keep exactly 5 open (unsettled) markets; 'queue' entries are used first, then generators.

markets.q: Who gets eliminated on DWTS Dedication Night (Tue Oct 20, 2026)?
markets.src: Official results as aired on ABC and posted by ABC (abc.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars, @DancingABC on X); backup: same-night recaps from People, TVLine or USA Today. Jenna Dewan dances with Alan Bersten this week (Val suspended); it's the same couple. No elimination tonight = void and refund. Double elimination: the first couple announced eliminated wins; if two are announced together, void. Withdrawal instead of a vote-off = void.

rule.how: Couple eliminated on the Oct 20 episode per ABC/@DancingABC or People/TVLine/USA Today recap. a=Ezra Frech, b=Amber Glenn, c=Maura Higgins, d=Harry Shum Jr., e=Jenna Dewan, f=Tyler Cameron, g=Julia Stiles, h=Tatyana Ali, i=Connor Wood, j=Jackson Olson. No elimination -> void. Double elimination -> first announced; announced together -> void. Withdrawal -> void.

markets.q: Highest judges' score for a single dance on Dedication Night (Oct 20): Over/Under 36.5 (out of 40)?
markets.src: Judges' scores for the Oct 20, 2026 episode as aired on ABC and listed in People/TVLine/USA Today score recaps or the DWTS Wikipedia Season 35 scoring table. Only the regular routine scores out of 40 count (4 judges incl. guest judge Kym Johnson). Void if the episode doesn't air by Oct 23, 2026 or scores aren't out of 40.

rule.how: max single-dance judges' total on Oct 20 (out of 40): >36.5 -> a, else b. Not out of 40 / not aired by 2026-10-23 -> void.

markets.q: Does any couple earn a perfect score (all 10s) on Dedication Night (Oct 20)?
markets.src: Judges' scores for the Oct 20, 2026 episode as aired on ABC and in People/TVLine/USA Today score recaps or the DWTS Wikipedia Season 35 scoring table. Void if the episode doesn't air by Oct 23, 2026.

rule.how: a if any routine on Oct 20 gets 10 from every judge, else b. Not aired by 2026-10-23 -> void.

markets.q: Who wins Dancing with the Stars Season 35 (finale Tue Nov 24, 2026)?
markets.src: Mirrorball Trophy winner announced on the Season 35 finale as aired on ABC and posted by ABC/@DancingABC; backup: People/TVLine/USA Today finale recaps. Void if no winner is crowned by Dec 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET.

rule.how: Season 35 Mirrorball winner. a=Ezra Frech, b=Amber Glenn, c=Maura Higgins, d=Harry Shum Jr., e=Jenna Dewan, f=Tyler Cameron, g=Julia Stiles, h=Tatyana Ali, i=Connor Wood, j=Jackson Olson. No winner by 2026-12-31 23:59 ET -> void.
